title: nutty mexican comte tacos
description: a rich, nutty, and velvety taco recipe featuring comte cheese, perfect for festive mexican nights. this recipe is low in sodium, making it a great option for those watching their salt intake.

ingredients.name: comte cheese
ingredients.notes: a rich and creamy french cheese

instructions: in a blender or food processor, combine chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, salt-free seasoning blend, and a pinch of black pepper. blend until smooth.
in a medium skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of unsalted butter over medium heat. add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
add the radishes and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly tender.
add the chopped cilantro, a squeeze of lime juice, and a sprinkle of cumin. cook for 1 minute, until the flavors have melded together.
warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
in a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat. add 1 tablespoon of nonstick cooking spray and swirl to coat.
add 2-3 tortillas to the skillet and cook for 30-45 seconds on each side, until slightly charred and pliable.
in a medium bowl, combine the crumbled comte cheese, chopped walnuts, and a sprinkle of cumin. mix until well combined.
to assemble the tacos, place a few spoonfuls of the chipotle sauce onto a warmed tortilla, followed by a spoonful of the comte cheese mixture.
top with a sprinkle of honey, a dollop of sour cream, a sprinkle of cotija cheese, and a sprinkle of chopped pecans.
repeat with the remaining ingredients and serve immediately.
garnish with sliced scallions, radishes, and a sprinkle of cilantro, if desired.
